articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn. , Oct. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Star Group, L.P. (the "Company" or "Star") (NYSE:SGU), a home energy distributor and services provider, today declared its quarterly distribution of $0.1850 per common unit for the three months ended September 30, 2025 .
articles.title: Star Group, L.P. Declares Quarterly Distribution of 18.50 Cents per Unit
